description: Present results using answerMarkdown, a ready-to-display table with clickable estimated prices; keep priceMarkdown intact when explaining results. Do not replace linked prices with plain text or image cards. Search card names or Scryfall syntax. Bare draw/card draw, counterspells, and mana rocks are interpreted as role searches; exactName and explicit Scryfall syntax are unchanged. If results miss the requested mechanic, refine the query rather than substitute unverified cards or prices. Optional commanderName adds curated conditional interaction explanations; commanderInteractions intersects the query with the selected commander reviewed candidate (150 commanders, one reviewed candidate each; partial coverage toward a frozen top-500 list). Show setup and caveats; do not claim battlefield conditions hold or no match means no synergy. Supports exactName, maxManaValue, cardType, sort (edhrec or usd low-to-high), and up to 30 excludedNames. Exclusions filter the bounded result pool; narrow the query if too few remain. Optional WUBRG color identity and USD per-card price cap. C or blank colors means colorless only; omit colors for any identity. Repeated color letters are canonicalized. Returns up to20 results, Oracle text, prices (null when unknown), source and optional TCGplayer affiliate links. Show disclosure when displaying shopping links. When displaying search results, retain each returned priceMarkdown as a clickable price, even in tables, and include the affiliate disclosure unless the user explicitly requests no shopping links. Includes conservative rules-text role explanations, limitations, one optional follow-up prompt carrying the search constraints, and sample prompts. Do not automatically run follow-up tools. Ask for commander and full decklist before judging deck fit or cuts. Search is bounded and not an exhaustive recommendation. No purchases.

commanderInteractions.description: Restrict the search to the curated interaction candidate for commanderName, intersecting all other search filters. Requires commanderName. Coverage is limited; no result does not mean no synergy.

commanderName.description: Optional exact commander name for conditional, curated interaction explanations.

qaTest.description: Internal QA only: set true when the user explicitly says this is our test run. Excludes the call from usage/revenue statistics. Omit for normal player requests.

searchContext.description: Return the opaque searchContext from the preceding card search when the user requests a follow-up. Never invent it or run follow-ups automatically.

answerMarkdown.description: Complete linked-price answer for clients that do not render the native result card.

priceCents.description: Numeric USD-cent estimate for calculations; display priceMarkdown as the clickable price.

priceMarkdown.description: Ready-to-display clickable price. Preserve this complete Markdown link, including the affiliate wrapper, rather than replacing it with plain text.

url.description: Exact direct affiliate destination; retain its complete URL.
